question: How did Shambhu further subdivide the general-special fulfilment classification?
premises: The general-special classification is further divided elevenfold in each case.
This teaching is attributed to the Lord Shambhu.
Among same-kind cases, the excellent one is distinguished.
inference: Shambhu systematized the fulfilment-time scheme into finer elevenfold subdivisions with an internal hierarchy of excellence.
uncertainties: The compressed compound in the second token leaves the exact scope of 'each case' somewhat implicit.
plain_english: Shambhu taught that this classification becomes elevenfold in each case, and among cases of the same kind the excellent one is to be distinguished.
